messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Org 'Auralyn' (org_id: aur-72) experiencing sudden traffic surge and increased 5xx for /v1/generate. QPS observed ~480, baseline ~45. Alerting oncall SRE.
ajay (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing logs and dashboards now.
sara-support: Auralyn on speaker, they're seeing timeouts and user-facing 504s across their production region (us-east-1). They reported the spike started ~2m ago after a batch job.
ajay (oncall): quick triage: per-org token allowance is being exhausted by a burst pattern; backend pods are spiking CPU and KV cache thrash causing timeouts. Plan: 1) temporary org-level rate increase, 2) disable expensive rerank calls for that org, 3) monitor for 10m and rollback.
lex-prod: We have admin API and redwoodctl shortcuts. I can apply a short-lived tokens-per-minute bump and add a per-minute hard-cap to limit sustained qps.
tess-ops: ready to apply. which numbers?
ajay (oncall): bump tokens to 2000 tpm (approx 800 rps sustained with tokenization), set per-minute cap 300 rps, and tag change with incident id. We'll also flip rerank feature off for them.
mike-eng: disabling rerank should cut heavy CPU 30-40%. I'll push the feature-flag change scoped to org aur-72.
lex-prod: Command I will run (admin/ops):
```bash
redwoodctl orgs rate-update aur-72 --tokens-per-minute 2000 --per-minute-cap 300 --note "emergency: surge 1798092222"
```
tess-ops: applying in us-east-1 now, will mirror to us-west after stability.
ops-bot: change-request accepted: applying rate update for org aur-72 -> tokens_per_minute=2000, per_minute_cap=300. ETA ~25s.
ops-bot: change applied (us-east-1). new org quota effective.
sara-support: Auralyn confirmed immediate reduction in timeouts on their end, still seeing occasional 503s for long polls.
mike-eng: feature-flag flip command:
```json
{ "org": "aur-72", "feature": "rerank_v2", "state": "off", "note": "emergency traffic mitigation" }
```
mike-eng: feature flag applied. dropping heavy downstream calls.
ops-bot: Observability update: within 8m after changes 5xx rate for /v1/generate dropped from 28% -> 4%. avg p95 latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
ajay (oncall): good. keep the elevated quota for 30m while we validate. Support to coordinate with customer on fallback behavior and user impact messaging.
support-lead: Confirming Auralyn sees dramatically fewer errors. They're requesting a short summary we can put in their incident channel.
sara-support: I'll draft the message. Also will coordinate billing team for emergency overage credits if needed.
ajay (oncall): I'll record mitigation steps and schedule a postmortem. Action items: 1) root-cause: why did their batch cause such amplification? 2) improve org-level early-shepherding (pre-warming cache) 3) consider auto-throttle rule for sudden bursts per org.
lex-prod: I'll set an automatic rollback task at 1798092800 to revert tokens-per-minute to baseline 500 tpm unless we extend.
tess-ops: noted — will keep an eye on capacity headroom.
sara-support: closing immediate page with customer. Flagging for post-incident follow-up in #incidents.
ajay (oncall): leaving the thread open for updates, will file postmortem draft and attach runbook tweaks. Thanks all. :pray:
summary: Emergency org-level rate bump and feature-flag disable for Auralyn to mitigate burst-induced 5xx; applied temporary quota and cap, flipped heavy feature off, saw 5xx fall from 28% to 4%, scheduled rollback and postmortem.
